subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Out of all, this is the _______ school in the city.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"famous"** means something that is well-known by many people, often for a particular reason. (प्रसिद्ध)

 
 
• **Example: **The Eiffel Tower is **famous** for its unique design and historical significance.
 
 
 
• **"Most famous"** is the superlative form of the word "famous," indicating the highest degree of fame among all others. (सबसे प्रसिद्ध)
 
 
• **Example: **Out of all the actors in Hollywood, he is the **most famous.**
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct word to use in the sentence is **"most famous"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **More famous** (ज़्यादा प्रसिद्ध): Comparative form of "famous," used to compare two entities.

 
 
• **Example:** This actor is more famous than his co-stars.
 
 
 
• **Famousest** (Incorrect form): "Famousest" is not a correct English word.
 
 
• **Example:** This word does not exist in standard English.
 
 
 
• **Famous** (प्रसिद्ध): Well-known by many people.
 
 
• **Example:** The Taj Mahal is a famous monument in India.
 
 

33:Tc10,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
